test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

He didn't eat a single morsel of food at his daughter's wedding.

options.text: A single morsel of food is not eaten by him at his daughter's wedding.
A single morsel of food was not eaten by him at his daughter's wedding.
A single morsel of food can not be eaten by him at his daughter's wedding.
A single morsel of food was not being eaten by him at his daughter's wedding.

solution:
The correct answer is **"A single morsel of food was not eaten by him at his daughter's wedding."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is negative and in Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + did not + V1 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + not + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Their cousin did not show them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were not shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject **"he"** is performing the action of not eating.
 
• To convert it to passive voice, we need to make the object (a single morsel of food) the subject and use a form of **"to be"** followed by the past participle of the verb (was not eaten).
 
• The preposition **"at"** remains in the same position.
 
• The agent (the person or thing that performs the action) is not necessary in passive voice, but if we want to include it, we can use the preposition "by" followed by the agent.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
